title: SCIENCE OF FOODS
description: Explores composition, functional properties, and structure of foods, including physical characteristics associated with ingredient modifications. Investigates food costs, production time, and complexity of food preparation through applied assignments and lab activities. Assesses industry processes and regulations that impact nutritional content and consumer food choices are discussed. Examines food system controversies from farm to table.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CH 121, 121NL, 221Z, 221HZ, 231 or 231H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in CH 121, CH 121NL, CH 221Z, CH 221HZ, CH 231 and CH 231H.
